snp1.1:1.1: Yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ visataṃ sappavisaṃ va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ urago jiṇṇam iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.
snp1.1:2.1: Yo rāgam udacchidā asesa bhisapupphaṃ va saroruhaṃ vigayha, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:3.1: Yo taṇham udacchidā asesaṃ saritaṃ sīghasaraṃ visosayitvā, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:4.1: Yo mānam udabbadhī asesaṃ naḷasetuṃ va sudubbalaṃ mahogho, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:5.1: Yo najjhagamā bhavesu sāraṃ vicinaṃ puppham iva udumbaresu, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:6.1: Yass' antarato na santi kopa itibhavābhavatañ ca vītivatto, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:7.1: Yassa vitakkā vidhūpitā ajjhattaṃ suvikappitā asesā, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:8.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī sabbaṃ accagamā imaṃ papañcaṃ, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:9.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī ‘sabbam vitatham idan' ti ñatvā loke, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:10.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī ‘sabbaṃ vitatham idan' ti vītalobho, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:11.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī ‘sabbaṃ vitatham idan' ti vītarāgo, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:12.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī ‘sabbaṃ vitatham idan' ti vītadoso, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:13.1: Yo nāccasārī na paccasārī ‘sabbaṃ vitatham idan' ti vītamoho, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:14.1: Yassānusayā na santi keci, mūlā akusalā samūhatāse, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:15.1: Yassa darathajā na santi keci oraṃ āgamanāya paccayāse, so bhikkhu . . . || ||
snp1.1:16.1: Yassa vanathajā na santi keci vinibandhāya bhavāya hetukappā, so bhikkhu . . . || || Yo nīvaraṇe pahāya pañca anigho tiṇṇakathaṃkatho
snp1.1:17.1: visallo, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ urago jiṇṇam iva tacaṃ purāṇan ti || || URAGASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
